players.bio: Abderrahman Rebbach (born 11 August 1998), commonly known as Abde, is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Spanish club Deportivo Alavés.

Adrián Rodríguez Giménez (born 12 December 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Spanish club Real Zaragoza, on loan from Deportivo Alavés. Born in Spain, he represents Argentina internationally.
Ander Guevara Lajo (born 7 July 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Alavés.
Abdelkabir "Abdel" Abqar (born 10 March 1999) is a Moroccan footballer who plays for La Liga club Deportivo Alavés as a centre-back.
Antonio Sivera Salvá (born 11 August 1996) is a Spanish footballer who plays for Deportivo Alavés as a goalkeeper.
Carles Aleñá Castillo (born 5 January 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Deportivo Alavés.
Carlos Nahuel Benavídez Protesoni (born 30 March 1998) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as central midfielder for La Liga club Deportivo Alavés.
Denis Suárez Fernández (born 6 January 1994) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Alavés.
Facundo Tomás Garcés (born 5 September 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Deportivo Alavés. Born in Argentina, he plays for the Malaysia national team.
Hugo Novoa Ramos (born 24 January 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back or a winger for Segunda División club CD Mirandés, on loan from Deportivo Alavés.

Jonathan Castro Otto (born 3 March 1994), commonly known as Jonny, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right or left-back for La Liga club Alavés. He began his career with Celta, making his debut with the first team at the age of 18 and going on to appear in 221 matches across all competitions. In 2018 he signed with Wolverhampton Wanderers, initially on loan.
Lucas Ariel Boyé (born 28 February 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Alavés.

Mariano Díaz Mejía (born 1 August 1993), better known as Mariano, is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga club Deportivo Alavés. Born in Spain, he plays for the Dominican Republic national team.
Miguel Rodríguez Vidal (born 29 April 2003) is a Spanish footballer who plays mainly as a right winger for Deportivo Alavés.
Mikel Rodríguez Ulacia (born 3 April 2002) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Deportivo Alavés.

Moussa Diarra (born 10 November 2000) is a professional footballer who plays for La Liga club Deportivo Alavés. Mainly a centre-back, he can also play as a left-back. Born in France, Diarra plays for the Mali national team.
Facundo Nahuel Tenaglia (born 21 February 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays for Spanish club Deportivo Alavés. Mainly a right-back, he can also play as a centre-back.
Nicolás Valentini (born 6 April 2001) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Italian Serie A club Hellas Verona on loan from Fiorentina.
Pablo Ibáñez Lumbreras (born 20 September 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Deportivo Alavés.

Antonio "Toni" Martínez López (born 30 June 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga club Deportivo Alavés. He has represented Spain internationally at youth level. Martínez began his senior career at Valencia Mestalla, before joining West Ham United in 2016. He was loaned to several English and Spanish clubs, then signed for Famalicão in 2019.
Youssef Enríquez Lekhedim (born 7 October 2005), known as Yusi, is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for La Liga club Alavés. Born in Spain, he represents the Morocco national team.
